description: This file defines the immutable class 'DittoMongoClientSettings' which encapsulates additional, optional configuration settings for a MongoDB client, specifically handling maximum query time. It provides a builder pattern for constructing instances with configurable max query duration, using Java Duration objects.

classes.name: DittoMongoClientSettings
classes.description: Immutable class representing additional MongoDB client settings, primarily the maximum query time.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for constructing 'DittoMongoClientSettings'.

methods.name: getMaxQueryTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum duration allowed for a MongoDB query.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Mutable builder class for 'DittoMongoClientSettings' allowing configuration of max query time.

methods.name: maxQueryTime
methods.description: Sets the maximum amount of time a MongoDB query may last using a Duration.

methods.name: maxQueryTime
methods.description: Sets the maximum amount of time a MongoDB query may last using amount and temporal unit.

methods.description: Constructs an immutable 'DittoMongoClientSettings' instance from builder properties.
